verdict.rationale: Automated retry of failed subscription payments is a fair question for a payments platform like dLocal, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows recurring-charge building blocks: saving a card and charging its card_id, wallet enrollments, and payment-status notifications. Nothing documents automatic retry logic, smart dunning, or recovery emails.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can automatically retry failed subscription payments with smart dunning and recovery emails
